questions.question: What is your favorite thing about PAX Silica

You’re walking down the hall — briskly, swiftly. But you're not late to anything, no. You have nowhere to go, nowhere to be. You bounce from room to room doing, enjoying, learning nothing.
You walk fast to get nothing done faster. You do nothing, eat, sleep, repeat.

But then, as the daily monotony continues to numb your mind, something — someONE crashes into you. And you start to see... nothing — you see nothing, but them. You feel nothing but the warmth of their skin. You hear nothing but the symphony of their voice: “Hala.” The numbness, ones so ingrained into your very being, was reduced to nothing, nothing but a scent — a familiar scent. People have told you that you underestimate yourself because you genuinely believe that you know nothing, but somehow... you know them. And as you look into the nothingness in their eyes, you can see that they know you 

As you slowly guide each other and regain balance, you both pause and let silence fall. What do you say?

choices.choice: The history of all hitherto societies is the history of class struggle
